
```python
base64_data = ''''''
padding = '=' * (4 - len(base64_data) % 4)
base64_data += padding
compressed_data = base64.b64decode(base64_data)
with open("output.gz", "wb") as f:
    f.write(compressed_data)
print("保存成功")
```
